builds.name: Demonic Ascension: five-target drain recovery
builds.summary: Investigate high four seconds of five-champion Demonic Ascension healing output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high four seconds of five-champion Demonic Ascension healing output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: R heals 15/30/45 + 0.05 AP + 1.5% bonus HP per second from each nearby qualifying enemy. At rank 3 five uninterrupted champion drains for four seconds nominally produce 20 times (45 + 0.05 AP + 0.015 bonus HP), before real tick timing, healing modifiers and missing-HP caps. Aura damage and Demonflare are different outputs.

ceiling.targetName: four seconds of five-champion Demonic Ascension healing
ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 10%, target HP 100%, observation 4s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop observed damage at death, cap observed healing at missing HP, and report raw output separately. Exactly 50 legally earned Soul Fragments, using the source 15 HP each, and exactly 500 earned Heartsteel HP; read actual final bonus HP. Owner begins at 10% health. Exactly five living enemy champions remain draining for four seconds, with enough Demonic Energy maintained by real contact. No new kills, soul collection, W healing or allied healing during observation.

kitEvidence.formula:
Swain frees the demon, which deals [15 / 25 / 35 + (0.04) × AP] magic damage and drains [15 / 30 / 45 + (0.05) × AP + (0.015) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Health per second from nearby enemies. His Demonic Energy depletes over time but can be recharged indefinitely by draining enemy Champions and is fully restored on Champion takedowns.

After [2] seconds and every [8] seconds thereafter, Swain can cast Demonflare while transformed, which deals [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage and Slows enemies by [50]%, decaying over [1.5]s.
